title: OpenAI announces new tools to combat CSAM, including an image classifier and warning screens to prevent users from accessing material that sexualizes children (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: OpenAI announces new tools to combat CSAM, including an image classifier and warning screens to prevent users from accessing material that sexualizes children — OpenAI today announced new tools to combat child sexual abuse material (CSAM) amid growing safety concerns around the use of AI tools.
